description: Non-parametric surrogate validation of nutation p-values

methods.f_test: F-test with N=12 phase bins, k=3 parameters (sinusoidal fit)
methods.permutation: Permutation test: shuffle 12 phase bin means across phase angles, N=100000
methods.ar1_surrogate: AR(1) red-noise surrogate: generate AR(1) time series with matched lag-1 autocorrelation, bin by nutation phase, fit sinusoid, N=100000

notes: F-test uses N=12 phase bins (not N=165M station pairs), giving correct p-values
Permutation test is distribution-free, does not assume Gaussian residuals
AR(1) surrogate test accounts for temporal autocorrelation in the coherence time series
AR(1) test for 18.6-year nutation uses day_of_year proxy (limited temporal resolution); full-date AR(1) test requires raw time series rerun
Lag-1 autocorrelation of coherence time series: -0.058 (effectively white noise)
